_doc: Baseline for tools/lint_durable_writers.py. Every durable writer that handles a parameter/prompt name and calls no masker in its own scope, with the reason it may. Enforced both ways: a writer not listed here fails, and an entry that no longer violates fails until it is deleted -- this list only shrinks. 'kind' is one of: masked-upstream (the value arrives already masked by a helper this matcher cannot follow), not-a-param (the matched name never reaches the write), operator-record (the operator's own typed text, kept as typed), residual (raw model-authored text persisted unmasked today; a known gap, not a permission).

writers.reason: The single action-audit writer. Every caller hands it params already masked by shadow_runtime._truncate_audit_params (ShadowRuntime._build_tool_audit_entry, ToolSandbox._after_successful_call, quick_task._audit_tool_success, each pinned by the R-P3b ledger tests); the writer itself does not re-mask.
Backend leg of append_action_audit: INSERTs the row it is given, whose params were masked by _truncate_audit_params before the call.
Postgres twin of the sqlite backend leg; same already-masked row.
The 'params' it writes are built by the exporter itself (format, artifact filename, row counts), not a tool call's arguments.

write_text persists only the chat entry's sha256 fingerprint (the prompt goes to the LLM, not to that file). append_user_fact persists LLM-extracted fact text derived from the operator's chat prompt, stamped content_derived and confirmed before it binds, but not masked: a secret the operator pasted can survive extraction verbatim.

Chat history: the operator's own typed prompt and the run's status/summary, the record the Chat page shows back. The task API redacts it on egress (task_api.project_task -> outbox.redact); on disk it is kept as typed. A secret the operator pastes into chat is persisted as pasted.
Same chat-history record as run_direct_task (status update for a queued chat submission).
Same chat-history record for the quick lane: the operator's prompt as typed and the answer.

Three write sites. append_action_audit persists _build_tool_audit_entry's row, masked by _truncate_audit_params (masked-upstream). Governor._ledger_append x2 persist the harness request including its model-authored spec (which can carry pending_tool.parameters) to harness_ledger/<eid>.jsonl, NOT masked (residual: a review log, unfenced in this slice).
